mic-drop-v1.png.studyPrompt: Native pixel-art pose study for the indie game Midlife Survivors. Match the reference for 16-bit pixel weight, upper left highlights, deep navy 1px outline #171C35, slate #303750/#526078, lavender #BFA8CF, teal #3E7775, sage #83A89A, cream #F2D7A1/#FFF0CF, coffee #EF9347. Flat opaque #FF00FF only behind sprites. No shadows, antialias, typography, brands or grid lines. Chunky stair-step squares that will still read at native size. Six isolated equal cells in one horizontal row. Same stage microphone in each, big silver-lavender rounded mesh grille with three short stepped bands, navy-charcoal tapered grip with a small warm-metal band. Each cell represents 24x40. Fixed floor baseline, first hangs nearly vertical, second tilts clockwise to the right, third hits head-first toward the right, fourth bounces slightly, fifth falls flat pointing right, sixth lies still with a tiny recoil. Fit full flattened silhouette with padding and keep shaft short enough to fit cell width.
